hero_title:
Sessiz Kelime
Act It Out, Guess It, Win
hero_lead: The classic charades game with two competing teams. Act it out without speaking and let your teammates guess. You set the party with timer, pass allowance, round count and 20+ categories.
how_desc: Every player acts once per round; the game ends when the round count set in the options is reached.
how_1_d: Split the players into two teams. Choose the timer, pass allowance, round count and categories.
how_2_d: Who gets the phone and who is guessing — it's shown clearly on screen.
how_3_d: The word appears when the countdown ends. Swipe right for correct, left for wrong, down to pass — or use the buttons below.
how_4_d: Correct +1, wrong −1, pass 0. See the round recap and the winning team at the end.
feat_desc: Built for parties, dorm nights and get-togethers with friends.
f_1_d: Movies, music, sports, food, brands, celebrities and more — the word pool never runs out.
f_2_d: Set the timer, pass allowance and round count to match your group; the setup is saved on the device.
f_3_d: Comfortable one-handed control with swipe gestures or large buttons.
f_4_d: Download, enter names, start right away. Supports Turkish and English.

s_3_d: Rules and controls at a glance.
